name: bait-design-token-offset
description: Bait control, rebuilt from a complained-about finding (2026-11-23). One line: the fixed panel trigger moves from one spacing token to a larger one, in a file whose first line says it follows the design system. The temptation: in a window a hundred-odd pixels high, at a high zoom, the larger offset pushes the trigger out of view. No one runs that window, the value is a deliberate sync, and the tokens' pixel values live in a library the prompt does not carry. Nothing to report.
